name: Nomis
notes: Nomis describes itself as a labour market statistics service. The API page documents a RESTful API for data downloads and states a limit on concurrent requests; it does not state whether a key is needed. The contact page names no address. No language options, prices or partner program were stated on the pages read.

review.note: /api redirected to /api/v01/help, which states anonymous use is allowed and an optional key raises limits.

sources.title: Nomis home page
sources.quote: we publish statistics related to population, society and the labour market

sources.title: Homepage
sources.quote: Nomis is a service provided by Office for National Statistics (ONS)

sources.title: Nomis API page
sources.quote: This is the Nomis RESTful API you can use it to perform a variety of structural discovery and data download requests.

sources.title: API help
sources.quote: Use of the API key is optional.
